translation:
Renshen San (人參散) treats heat in the body with headache, or accumulated heat with sallow emaciation, or fever with aversion to cold, or retained heat with chills and shivering, or diaphragm phlegm with vomiting, vexation-heat and vexation-thirst, or dryness-thirst with diarrhea, or eye disease and mouth sores, or sore and swollen throat, or wind-fire with dizziness and dimness, or steaming heat with vacuous sweating, and lung atrophy (肺痿) with consumptive cough. All transformations of pathogenic heat with damage and depletion of the true yin are suitable to take it.

Gypsum (石膏) (one liang), mirabilite (寒水石) (two liang), talc (滑石) (four liang), licorice (甘草) (two liang), ginseng (人參) (half liang).

Grind the above into a fine powder; take two qian each time, mixed with warm water, or cold water is also acceptable.
translator_notes: 或冷水亦得 rendered as 'or cold water is also acceptable'.
